clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonetalon Peak, Sleepers' Key helps guard a sacred druidic vault. Night elf druids made it one of three enchanted keys for the Talon Den Hoard.

The Talon Den rises on Stonetalon Peak as a redoubt and sanctum for the druids of Kalimdor. To guard sacred relics and potent treasures from unwanted attention, night elf keepers built a system of locks and hidden caches. Sleepers' Key is one of three keys that together form a protective ward. The key lies in a secluded cache deep in the den, opened with the Gatekeeper's Key hidden near the threshold. The Claw Key and the Barrow Key complete the set. Set all three into the Talon Den Hoard's stone locks, and the ward fades, revealing the ancient items within.
